sale.text: Rare opportunity in the heart of Victorian Village! This distinctive 3,697-square-foot brick property offers 5 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and a versatile layout suited for owner-occupants or investors. Featuring original woodwork, hardwood floors, and historic architectural details throughout, the main two levels include a spacious living room, formal dining room, large kitchen, and bonus den ideal for a home office or additional living space, along with 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms. The second-floor primary suite includes its own laundry and sink area, with additional laundry facilities in the basement. The third floor features a separate 2-bedroom, 1-bath living arrangement with its own kitchen, living room, and laundry, accessible by both an interior staircase and a separate exterior entrance. This space can function as an extension of the main residence or offer the opportunity to live in one portion while renting the other. Exterior features include a 2-car garage, expansive driveway with parking for approximately 8 additional vehicles, and yard space. Conveniently located near the Short North, Goodale Park, OSU Wexner Medical Center and Downtown Columbus. An opportunity for a primary residence or potential short-term or long-term rental investment.

Additional improvements include slate roof repairs (2024), box gutter sealing (2026), furnace (2017), AC (2022), and water heater (2019).
